title: Good-range quasi-abelian cohomological restriction when K′ acts transitively on K/LK
source_version: Official SIGMA 21 (2025) journal PDF and native TeX; acquired 2026-09-30; exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The author has to preserve the good range after restriction using root convexity, control derived-functor injectivity on multiplicity spaces, and connect quasi-abelian PBW filtrations to irreducibility over the invariant enveloping algebra. The earlier root and natural-transformation lemmas are included instead of treating the final branching statement as a named-theorem application.
author: Masatoshi Kitagawa
